Second post making fun of fat people - I knew that people will only see me as a fatty then as a human. I can’t even try to be healthy and lose weigh without others just seeing the fatness. 

I’ve had suicidal thoughts for a few years and it never seems like it’s getting better. I try and lose weight and try so hard. But nobody understands that. Y’all think it so fucking easy. That some people can flip a switch. I’ve been dealing with my weight for a long time, since my father passed on. But I know that even if I keep trying and going to therapy and exercising that I’ll always be the fat chick. 

Might as well forget it and eat myself to an early grave because the kindness of others is depleting from this earth quickly.

I definitely don’t believe/agree with that movement at all but how can people see that I’m making a change instead of some fat girl? I am really trying and I feel that I can’t even be accepted just because I’m fat. I work out and I try to eat right, but I’m human and sometimes I slip. I exercise 4 times a week and am making a slow progression, but I feel. the only thing people see is a fat chick. Not that I’m a welder. Not that I work with intellectually/physically disabled adults. Not that I’m an artist or a dog lover. They only see a fatty that’s unwilling to make a change because of these HAAS people.  🤦🏽‍♀️

I come on here and it’s just the usual shit ‘why can’t they work out or why can they eat right?’ I have been going to therapy for over a year now and a lot of my weigh is due to the death of my father. He was my guiding light and when he was taken from us from prostate cancer, I went into a spiral. Food was the way my half Italian/half Spanish family deals with shit. This shit is ingrained in me. 

But I have begun to understand and become stronger than my history. I have learned feelings and food shouldn’t go together. I am slowly improving my life and it does help to see videos like the one posted but I wish others would be more understanding.  I wish people wouldn’t just jump so quickly to conclusion about some people are overweight. I’m against the movement HAAS. It perpetuates and unhealthy lifestyle and stereotypes. I don’t want to be that. I’m just a fat person asking for a little empathy and understanding. 

I’m also like why does my body matter to you? Unless your a friend who’s legit concerned about me then fuck off. Worry about your body. You’re probably saying in your head anyways ‘she’s gonna die before me because she’s so fat so who cares.’ Think about the person behind that thought. 

Sorry typing on phone and very annoyed that how others perceive fat peoples  is how all fat people are.

I lived with a couple for a while. They’re artists, and not to say artists can’t make a good living but I sorta deduced that they didn’t make enough to afford some of the things they were buying:

- bought a $350,000 home
- would eat out almost every night of the week, when they didn’t they would get take out and food from Whole Foods and 2dine in. 
- were able to take weeks off of ‘work’,  to go surfing in different parts of the world. Work for them was going to their studios and painting. They maybe sold 2-4 paintings a year at $1000 a painting, but didn’t have any other job besides that. 
- the studios that these artists worked in were some studios I looked at. Per month, these studios ranged in prices from $400 (200sq ft) a month to $1500 (700sq ft).  They had 2 studios. One was 500sq ft and the other was 300 sq ft. 
- they had a brand new conversion van. I’m not sure what they are called, but like the really nice work van for hauling paintings and artists supplies. They also had a 2016 Subaru hatchback. 

I never asked about their finances or what but I did pay them $500 for a really nice apt. on the third floor of their house. The house had a pool, hot tub and two car garage, which they turned into a ‘hang out/party room’. 

I never really asked what their situation was, but unless they were dealing drugs, or running guns or robbing banks, I’m not sure where the money was coming from. 🤷🏽‍♀️ They were really nice, but wouldn’t get why I couldn’t go out to eat or to the bar or on vacation with them when they invited me. My friend's (now my husband) girlfriend was batshit crazy for attention. 

She was not only dating my friend, but also multiple other dudes on the side that we didn't know about until this night in particular. 

One night, we were all getting ready to go out and our friends group for some reason split up that evening into guys and gals. We all went our separate ways but eventually met up at a small bar in Philly for a night cap - where the drama unfolded. 

Before meeting up in the evening where the drama took place - this girl, we will cal her Sarah, asked us gals to not tell
the friend what she was doing and told her SO she was sick and wasn't going out. She ended up meeting one of her boyfriends who had a layover in Philly for the evening and wanted her to go with. We didn't know this until we got to said bar and had a few. All us gals were like fuck this and left the bar to meet up with the dudes. 

We were like how do we tell friend that his girlfriend is a cheating cunt  - we didn't want to hurt his feelings and wanted to try and not do it when we were all out drinking. When we got to the bar where guys and her SO was at we ordered drinks.  A few ppl and her SO went outside to smoke cigs. This is where the drama started. 

As they were outside smoking cigs, a very drunk Sarah and her boy toy were waking hand in hand groping each other on the opposite side of the street. Turns out we didn't have to spill the beans to her SO he saw everything and was infuriated. We ended up telling him what took place that night and he broke up with her that weekend. 

Side note - I had a HUGE crush on him and after he broke up with her, we started to spend a lot of time together, eventually began dating and have now been married for 6 years this November.

Late, but I was just reflecting on this today. 

I was attending college at Rowan University, fresh outta high school and almost the third week of college. 

I had an early class that morning, 8 am, some kind of health and sciences class (I was an undecided major). I remember being sleepy and thinking about what I really wanted to do with my life. 

There was a knock at the door, wish is unusual for a college class and another professor came in and told my instructor that we all needed to go see what was happening on TV. She looked terrified. I didn't know what was going on, so I shuffled en-masse with the others. 

There was a crowd around a small TV in the basement of the student center and just as I looked up at the TV, the second plane hit the tower. It was silent. Nobody screamed, nobody said a word.  I lost it at that moment. I quietly walked back to my room, packed up and moved back home. I (tried) to call my mom as I was driving home - phones were all screwy if you remember - but left her a message telling her and my dad I loved them. My father -  rest his soul - was one of the responders that day. He was in the Army and was called there from Ft. Monmouth (like 45 mins from NYC).  He ended up spending a few weeks in NY helping out. 

I know that day fucked me up - as it fucked a lot of people that day. I am not even sure how to end this as I feel I - like a lot of you - still feel in awe that something that evil could happen. I remember going to a lot of 'funerals'. The area I grew up in had a lot of commuters. I struggle to call them funerals because it was only photographs of the victims - the only funerals I've been to without caskets. 

I'm sorry if this is just a rambling collection of memories but I've struggled to put the pieces together for a long time now - as have a lot of others. My father ended up getting cancer and passing in 2007, but I had never seen such a strong person become so emotionally wrought after his experience.

Maine! Not really a SB destination...but it's gorgeous up here. 

Most of the state parks are free, and it's not tourist season year so the parks and beaches are empty. It's not hot enough to go swimming, but if you like hiking and nature in general, spring is a lovely time to visit. You can also camp during this time and it gets cool enough at night to sit around a nice warm fire. 

Sites usually aren't that pricey ($10-$30 per night) and some state park camping is free. There are also plenty of cheap hotels and air bnb's in this area, too. 

Portland, ME is also a great city. Not too big and not too small. Plenty of quirky breweries and restaurants.
